title.en: LCA module of the CIRPASS-2 EU DPP Core Ontology

description.en:
LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) module of an EU DPP (Digital Product Passport) core ontology proposal of the CIRPASS-2 European project.

SCOPE
This module covers the environmental-performance metadata that a DPP is required to carry under ESPR. It supports both (a) general LCA studies of any product, expressed via eudpp:LCAStudy, and (b) Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) conforming to EN 15804+A2 with EF 3.1 characterisation, expressed via eudpp:EPDStudy (a subclass of LCAStudy). The controlled vocabulary of named individuals (impact indicators, inventory indicators, lifecycle modules, characterisation methods) follows EN 15804+A2 and EF 3.1. The module aligns structurally with the ILCD+EPD v1.3 data format (https://indatawg.github.io/ILCD-EPD-Data-Format/) and extends it with richer OWL semantics.It also relates to LCAnet/IA module (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#).

DEPENDENCIES
This module has dependencies to the following EU DPP Core Ontology (CO) modules: ACTOR and P_DPP via CON.

comment.en: Source that is a Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules document, the European Commission Environmental Footprint methodology's product-category-specific rules. Parallel role to PCR but for PEF studies (rather than EN 15804+A2 EPD studies). Used by an LCAStudy via eudpp:referenceToPEFCR. NEW in v1.9.7.

EU Environmental Footprint single score (also referred to as PEF score), computed as a normalised and weighted aggregate of the 16 EF impact-category results. Expressed in dimensionless points (Pt). The applied normalisation factors and weighting set are determined by the methodology version (e.g. EF 3.1 per JRC EUR 31414 EN), which is resolvable from the study via eudpp:hasComplianceDeclaration on its referenced eudpp:ComplianceSystem source.

An aggregated single-score indicator computed as the normalised and weighted sum of a set of impact-category results. 
Holds one named individual eudpp:ind_EF_singleScore representing the EU Environmental Footprint single score (PEF score). The applied normalisation factors and weighting set are not modelled here as properties; they are determined by the active EF / PEF methodology version, which is resolvable via the study's eudpp:hasComplianceDeclaration link to a eudpp:ComplianceSystem source. 
Results computed for an EnvironmentalFootprintScore individual are eudpp:LCIAResult instances.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCA ontology: third sibling subclass of eudpp:LCAResult alongside eudpp:LCIAResult and eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult, introduced to represent the aggregated EF single score result.

comment.en:
A normalized and weighted aggregate LCA result expressing the overall environmental performance of a product system as a single dimensionless score, computed by applying the Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) method (Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279). 
Aggregates the characterised results of all 16 EF 3.1 impact categories through normalization and weighting factors.
Instances of this class quantify the EF single score indicator (ind_EF_singleScore, an EnvironmentalFootprintScore individual) via quantifiesIndicator.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element complianceDeclarations/compliance.

comment.en: A statement that the LCA or EPD study complies with a given compliance system (typically ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, or a PEFCR). The level of compliance (fully, partially, not compliant) is recorded via eudpp:complianceStatus.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: corresponds to the element LCIAResults/LCIAResult when the indicator is a characterised impact indicator.

comment.en: A characterised LCA result quantifying one LCIA indicator (an EN15804ImpactIndicator or an LCIAImpactIndicator ) for a product system. Each instance is linked to exactly one indicator individual via quantifiesIndicator, and carries its numerical value per life-cycle module via hasLCAModuleValue.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element MaterialFootprint (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#MaterialFootprint) of the IA module.

comment.en:
An InventoryIndicatorResult that "refers to the total amount of raw materials extracted to meet final consumption demands" (ESPR Art. 2(26)).

Modelled as an inventory-level result rather than a characterised LCIA result, as it aggregates raw material extraction flows without applying characterisation factors.
No single EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator individual is pinned via quantifiesIndicator; the link is left to individual instances, as material footprint spans multiple EN 15804+A2 resource use inventory indicators (PERE, PENRE, SM, RSF, NRSF, etc.).
Source representing a background LCI database used for the LCA modelling (e.g. ecoinvent, GaBi/Sphera, Okobaudat).
The EPD study is declared fully compliant with the referenced compliance system.
The EPD study is declared partially compliant with the referenced compliance system; deviations should be documented on the associated review or in accessRestrictions.
The EPD study is declared not compliant with the referenced compliance system.
Level of compliance declared by a ComplianceDeclaration relative to its compliance system. Enumeration of 3 named individuals (fullyCompliant, partiallyCompliant, notCompliant).

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element CarbonFootprint (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#CarbonFootprint) of the IA module.

comment.en:
An LCIAResult that "means the sum of greenhouse gas emissions and greenhouse gas removals in a product system, expressed as CO equivalents and based on a life cycle assessment using the single impact category of climate change". (ESPR Art 2 25))
 
It quantifies the global warming potential of a product over a 100-year time horizon.
Instances of this class quantify either the EN 15804+A2 individual "GWP-total - Global Warming Potential (total)" (ind_GWPtotal, an EN15804ImpactIndicator) or the EF 3.1 "Climate Change EF" indicator (ind_EF_climateChange, an LCIAImpactIndicator), depending on the reporting framework of the EPD or LCA study.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: corresponds to the element LCIA Method Data Set, which is used in practice for both LCIA method and inventory indicator methods.
LCAnet: relates to the element Method (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#Method) in the IA module.

comment.en:
A life-cycle assessement method that produces values for one indicator from an inventory of elementary flows. 
Covers both (a) characterised LCIA methods (which apply characterisation factors to compute a midpoint impact result), and (b) inventory aggregation methods (which sum / aggregate inventory flows to produce an inventory-indicator result, e.g. the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators FW, HWD, PERE etc. defined as inventory-level by the standard's calculation rules).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: corresponds to the element epd:amount inside LCIAResult/other.

comment.en:
One numerical LCA-result value (impact or inventory-indicator) for a specific EN 15804+A2 life-cycle module (A1-A3, A4, ..., D) and optionally a specific scenario. 
It carries eudpp:amount (the numeric value), eudpp:forLifeCycleModule, optionally eudpp:forScenario, and eudpp:isDeclared (boolean: true if the module is declared with this value; false if the module is explicitly not declared for this indicator).
Source representing the published PDF or HTML EPD document itself (as distinct from the ILCD+EPD machine-readable EPDStudy).

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element ImpactCategoryIndicator (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#ImpactCategoryIndicator) of the IA module.

EF 3.1 / PEF impact category. Colloquially known as the carbon footprint of the product. JRC characterisation factors per EUR 31414 EN (2023).

A characterised impact indicator outside the EN 15804+A2 selection — direct subclass of eudpp:LCAIndicator, sibling of eudpp:EN15804Indicator. Holds the 16 official EF 3.1 / PEF impact category indicators as named individuals (Andreasi Bassi et al., JRC, 2023). 
These are the impact indicators used by general LCA studies (eudpp:LCAStudy) following the EU Environmental Footprint method, distinct from the EN 15804+A2 set used by EPDStudy. 
The two sets overlap conceptually — both have e.g. a "Climate change" indicator with kg CO2-eq — but differ operationally: EN 15804+A2 splits Climate change into four sub-indicators (total, fossil, biogenic, luluc) and selects 6 "with caveats" indicators with EN-specific reporting rules; EF 3.1 keeps Climate change as one indicator and presents 16 categories at one aggregation level.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element LcaModel (https://w3id.org/lcanet/core#LcaModel) of the Core module, which represents an LCA instance.

comment.en:
A life-cycle assessment study of a product, conducted per ISO 14040/14044, producing one or more LCA results. The general study container, applicable to any product whether or not the study follows EN 15804+A2. 
Carries study-level metadata (UUID, dataset version, name, reference year, license, copyright, ILCD format version, compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews, references to data sources / background databases / PEFCR, etc.). 
Cross-module link from a product to this class is provided by the Connector property eudpp:hasLCAStudy.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element Source Data Set.

comment.en: A bibliographic or documentary source referenced from an LCA study, EPD study or LCIA Method. Abstract superclass; concrete source instances typically use one of the more specific subclasses (PCR, LCAMethodReport, BackgroundDatabase, ComplianceSystem, ReviewReport, EPDDocument).

An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the net consumption of fresh water resources in a product system. 
This class is typically associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator “Use of net fresh water” (FW), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed to allow for future indicator additions or revised indicator frameworks.

comment.en:
A modelled life-cycle module per EN 15804+A2 (product stage A1-A3, construction A4-A5, use stage B1-B7, end-of-life C1-C4, benefits/loads D). Enumeration of 18 named individuals. 
Note that moduleA1A3 (aggregated product stage) is an alternative reporting form of A1+A2+A3; an EPD that reports A1-A3 should not additionally report A1, A2, A3 separately for the same indicator/scenario.
Exported-energy inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (electrical energy, thermal energy).
Resource-use inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (primary energy, secondary materials, secondary fuels, water).
Waste-output inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (hazardous, non-hazardous, radioactive waste disposed).
Additional 6 characterised impact indicators of EN 15804+A2 that must be reported with the standard caveat statement (Table 4).
Valorisation-output inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (components for re-use, materials for recycling, materials for energy recovery).
Core set of 13 characterised impact indicators mandatory for EN 15804+A2 EPDs (Table 3).

Grouping of the EN 15804+A2 indicators based on the printed standard's tables: core impact (Table 3), impact indicators with caveats (Table 4), resource use (Table 5 resource use), waste categories (Table 5 waste), output flows valorisation (Table 5 output flows), exported energy (Table 5 output flows). Enumeration of 6 named individuals.
Reviewer independent of the organisations involved. Acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.
Reviewer not involved in the work but belonging to the same organisation or legally linked organisation. Acceptable only for generic data per InData.
Panel of at least three independent internal or external reviewers, chaired by an independent external reviewer.
Reviewer independent of the organisations involved and accredited by an independent accreditation body. Highest level acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.
Reviewer involved in data collection or modelling, or representing the process/product system. Not acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.
The dataset has not been reviewed.
Kind of critical-review/verification performed on a dataset. Enumeration matching ILCD TypeOfReviewValues.

An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of renewable secondary material and fuel inputs in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators “Use of renewable secondary fuels” (RSF) or “Use of non-renewable secondary fuels” (NRSF), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed, as the scope of renewable material inputs may evolve.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element Methodology (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#Methodology) of the IA module.

comment.en: European Commission Environmental Footprint method, version 3.1. Mandated by EN 15804+A2 as the characterisation basis for the 13 core and 6 with-caveat impact indicators.
European Commission Environmental Footprint method, version 3.0. Predecessor of EF 3.1; some characterisation factors differ.
IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (2021) global-warming-potential characterisation factors, 100-year time horizon.

Inventory calculation rules defined by EN 15804+A2 itself for the 18 resource-use / waste / output-flow inventory indicators (PERE, PERM, ... EEE, EET). This "methodology" is inventory-level rather than characterised; it is distinguished here from EF 3.1 because the inventory indicators do not use EF characterisation factors.
CML-IA (Institute of Environmental Sciences, Leiden University) baseline 2002 methodology. Used by EN 15804+A1 (predecessor of +A2).
ReCiPe methodology version 2016 (midpoint and endpoint). Not used by EN 15804+A2 but frequently used for non-construction-products LCAs.

A named, versioned LCA methodology (a coherent set of LCA methods sharing principles and a set of characterisation factors), to which one or more Method instances belong. 
Each individual SHOULD carry a skos:altLabel giving a short code (e.g. "EF 3.1") and eudpp:methodologyVersion giving the version identifier.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: corresponds to the element AreaOfProtectionValues.

comment.en: Damage area addressed by an LCIA method via the LCIA Impact Category class using the addressesAoP object property. A closed enumeration of 5 individuals.

An LCA result quantifying impacts associated with land occupation and transformation in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 land use indicator (LU), which is characterised under EF 3.1. No formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed; note that LU sits at the boundary between inventory and impact in EN 15804 and may be refined in future ontology versions.

comment.en: Fraction of nutrients reaching freshwater end compartment, in kg P-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator. ERRATUM: the published text of EN 15804:2012+A2:2019 states the unit as 'kg PO4-eq' for this indicator, but the characterisation factors used by the EF 3.1 implementation operate on phosphorus (P), so the correct unit when reporting results against EF 3.1 characterisation factors is 'kg P-eq'. This ontology adopts the corrected unit. See JRC / EPD programme clarifications for details.

Global Warming Potential for fossil-fuel-related GHG emissions, in kg CO2-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

comment.en: Abiotic depletion potential for fossil resources, in MJ (net calorific value). Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.
Particulate-matter-related incidence of disease, in disease incidence. EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat: to be reported with the standard caveat statement per EN 15804+A2 Table 4.

labels.en: PM - Potential incidence of disease due to PM emissions

comment.en: Abiotic depletion potential for non-fossil resources (minerals and metals), in kg Sb-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

labels.en: ADPE - Abiotic Depletion Potential (elements, minerals and metals)

comment.en: Eutrophication accumulated exceedance for terrestrial compartments, in mol N-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

An EN 15804+A2 characterised impact indicator (core set of 13 or the 6 additional "with caveats" indicators). Characterised via the EF 3.1 characterisation models. Results computed for this indicator are eudpp:LCIAResult instances.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element LcaResult (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#LcaResult) of the IA module.

comment.en:
Abstract class for any LCA computation output of a study. Has three subclasses: 
eudpp:LCIAResult (characterised impact result) which applies characterisation factors of an LCIA method, eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult (aggregated inventory-indicator result) whcih is a sum/aggregation over the inventory without characterisation, and eudpp:EnvironmentalFootprintScoreResult which represents the aggregated EF single score result. 

In the regulatory sense of ESPR Art. 2(24), some characterized individuals of LCAResult constitute environmental footprints — quantifications of environmental impacts of a product throughout its life cycle.Other LCAResult instances, however, fall outside the strict ESPR definition. For this reason, LCAResult is linked to the ESPR "Environmental Footprint" concept via skos:broadMatch rather than owl:equivalentClass.

An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the consumption of primary energy resources — renewable and non-renewable — in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 primary energy indicators (e.g. PERE, PERM, PERT, PENRE, PENRM, PENRT), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed, as energy consumption may span multiple indicators depending on the study scope.

An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of secondary (recycled) material inputs in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator “Use of secondary material” (SM), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed.
Source holding the complete critical-review / verification report referenced from a Review.

An LCA study that conforms to EN 15804+A2 with EF 3.1 characterisation, i.e. an Environmental Product Declaration. Inherits all study-level metadata from eudpp:LCAStudy (compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews, LCA results, etc.) and adds EPD-specific properties: ILCD+EPD format version (eudpp:epdFormatVersion), registration number, expiry date, reference to the published EPD document (eudpp:EPDDocument via referenceToOriginalEPD), reference to the applicable Product Category Rules (eudpp:PCR via referenceToPCR). EN 15804+A2 module values per LCAResult are used to populate per-life-cycle-module values. Replaces v1.9.4's mixed structure and v1.9.5's eudpp:EPDDataSet.

An indicator defined by EN 15804+A2 (core impact, impact with caveats, resource use, waste output, or output-flow indicator). 
Subclass of the abstract eudpp:LCAIndicator parent. 
Note: an EN15804Indicator individual is the indicator definition; a result computed for that indicator is an eudpp:LCAResult instance (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult sibling).

A specific LCA result representing an aggregated inventory-indicator result computed for an EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (Table 5: resource use, waste categories, output flows). 
Important disambiguation: this class represents the AGGREGATED inventory-indicator value (e.g. total kg of HWD across A1-A3 for one product), as printed in EN 15804+A2 EPD tables and computed by a Method instance. It is NOT the raw flow-level life-cycle inventory (LCI) result of a process (which would be a list of elementary-flow exchanges with amounts and units, and is out of scope for this DPP-oriented LCA module).

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element ImpactCategory (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#ImpactCategory) of the IA module.

A mid-point impact category that an LCAMethod addresses. A closed enumeration.
Source that documents a life-cycle impact assessment (LCIA) method (e.g. the EF 3.1 method description).

An EN 15804+A2 inventory-level indicator (resource use, waste disposed, or output flow for valorisation / exported energy). Not characterised; value is an aggregated inventory quantity. Results computed for this indicator are eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult instances.

Abstract umbrella class for an indicator definition (impact or inventory category) that an eudpp:Method calculates values for. 
Each instance identifies exactly one method under which it is computed; this constraint is formalised as owl:maxCardinality 1 on eudpp:computedByMethod. 
Note: an indicator individual is the indicator DEFINITION (e.g. "FW – Net use of fresh water, in m3"); a numerical value computed for that indicator on a specific study is an eudpp:LCAResult instance (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult).
Source that is a Product Category Rules document (EN 15804+A2 Table 2 Line 1). Used in EN 15804+A2 EPDStudy via eudpp:referenceToPCR.

A standard or programme against which an LCA or EPD study is declared compliant, such as ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR programmes, or a specific programme operator's scheme.

Link from an LCAStudy to a background source. It can be a (a) documentation (e.g. an LCA project report, safety data sheet, or explanatory material) - covering the ILCD+EPD element referenceToExternalDocumentation on dataSetInformation, (b) databases or, (c)  literature sources used for modelling.
Level of compliance declared by a ComplianceDeclaration (fully compliant, partially compliant, or not compliant).

The Universally Unique Identifier of this LCA / EPD study, as mandated by ILCD+EPD as the primary persistent identifier. Once a study is created and a UUID is generated, the UUID stays the same forever; any change increments eudpp:dataSetVersion. String formatted as an RFC 4122 UUID (36 characters, hyphenated).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element epd24:manufacturers/epd24:manufacturer

comment.en: Links an LCA study to a manufacturer record documenting the manufacturers whose data is included in the study.

Version of the specific LCIA or Inventory method instance (where applicable). Captures method-instance-level versioning, distinct from methodology-level versioning (eudpp:methodologyVersion on LCAMethodology).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element LCIAResult/other/epd:amount.

comment.en: Link from an LCAResult (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult) to one of its per-module (and optionally per-scenario) numerical values.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element publicationAndOwnership/licenseType.

comment.en: License applicable to the LCA / EPD study.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element referenceToExternalDocumentation on LCIAMethodDataSet/dataSetInformation.

comment.en: Link from a Method to the external documentation describing the method.

Link between an LCIAImpactCategory and the Area(s)-of-protection it addresses.
1..n cardinality: a single impact category can address several Areas of Protection — for example, ozone depletion affects both Natural Environment and Human Health.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element usesCM (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#usesCM) in the IA module.

comment.en: Link from an Method to its characterisation-model block (where applicable; inventory-only methods may not have one).

Link from an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to one of its LCA results. Range is the abstract eudpp:LCAResult; sub-properties eudpp:hasLCIAResult and eudpp:hasInventoryResult narrow the result to the corresponding sibling subclass. Querying for eudpp:hasLCAResult retrieves both kinds of results in one go.
Version identifier of an LCAMethodology individual (e.g. "3.1" for EF 3.1, "2002" for CML 2002).
Date on which the review was completed. Important for DPP consumers to assess whether the review is still current.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element includedInMethodology (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#includedInMethodology) in the IA module.

comment.en: Link from a Method to one or several LCAMethodology individuals it belongs to (e.g. eudpp:methodology_EF3_1). Cardinality 1..n: a single method can be classified into more than one methodology (for example, when two methodologies share the same characterisation factors for one indicator).

True if this module value is declared in the study (has a numerical amount), false if the module is explicitly marked as not declared (ND / MND) for this indicator/scenario. Absence of the LCIAModuleValue triple altogether means the module was not in scope of the study (MNA - module not applicable).

Link from an LCAResult (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult) to the LCAIndicator individual that this result quantifies. 
This is the primary semantic identity of a result: a result is a quantification of an indicator, not of a method. 
Cardinality: exactly 1 per result instance.
Range: LCAIndicator (covers both EN15804Indicator individuals and non-EN-15804 indicators).
Version of the characterisation model used (e.g. "IPCC AR6 2021" vs "IPCC AR5 2013", which give different GWP100 values).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element complianceDeclarations/compliance. Domain widened in v1.9.7 from EPDStudy to LCAStudy.

comment.en: Link from an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to a ComplianceDeclaration. Compliance can be declared against any standard relevant to the study type (ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR-specific rules, etc.).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element LCIAResults/LCIAResult when the indicator is an EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use, waste, output flows).

comment.en: Sub-property of eudpp:hasLCAResult; range narrowed to eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult.

Link from an LCAIndicator individual to the IndicatorMethod instance that describes how this indicator is computed — its impact model, impact category, methodology reference, reference report, and ILCD method metadata. 
Cardinality: at most 1 per indicator individual."

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element impactCategory on LCIAMethodDataSet.
LCAnet: relates to the element hasImpactCategory (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#hasIC) in the IA module.

comment.en: Impact category addressed by the Method.
Link from an LCAStudy to a background LCI database used for the modelling (1..n). Sub-property of eudpp:hasExternalSource.

sourceVocabulary.value: LCAnet: relates to the element assessIC (https://w3id.org/lcanet/ia#assessIC) in the IA module.

comment.en: Link from an LCIA impact indicator to the mid-point impact category it characterises. Multiple indicators may assess the same category (e.g. Eutrophication, freshwater and Eutrophication, marine both relate to Eutrophication). This property expresses a conceptual classification link, not equivalence.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element publicationAndOwnership/copyright. Modelled as xsd:boolean per the ILCD+EPD schema definition (two-valued).

comment.en: True if a copyright applies to the LCA / EPD study, false otherwise.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element publicationAndOwnership/dataSetVersion.

comment.en: Version number of this LCA / EPD study instance, independent of the ontology version. Format: major.minor.sub-minor (e.g. "02.00.011").

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element epd2:expirationDateOfEPD on time/other.

comment.en: Date on which the EPD's validity expires. EN 15804+A2 EPDs are typically valid for five years from publication.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element review/referenceToCompleteReviewReport.

comment.en: Link from a Review to the full review report.

Relates an EN15804 impact indicator to the conceptually corresponding EF 3.1 / PEF LCIA impact indicator. 
The two indicators are not equivalent — EN15804 indicators are EPD-specific reporting slots defined by EN15804+A2, while LCIA impact indicators follow the broader EF 3.1 characterisation framework. This property records a conceptual correspondence without implying any equivalence.

sourceVocabulary.value:
ILCD base: Corresponds to the element referenceToIncludedMethods.
ILCD+EPD LCIA Method Data Sets can represent either a single LCIA or inventory method (one indicator) or a methodology (a collection/list of methods); this property is used only in the latter case.

comment.en: Link from a Method (a collection of methods sharing a methodology such as "EF 3.1") to each of the individual-indicator method instances it aggregates.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element referenceToPCR.

comment.en: Link from an EPDStudy to the Product Category Rules document(s) it follows (1..n).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element publicationAndOwnership/registrationNumber.

comment.en: Identifying number issued by the EPD programme operator (typically visible on the EPD document). Distinct from the dataset UUID.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element validation/review.

comment.en: Link from an LCAStudy to a critical-review / verification record.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element accessRestrictions.

comment.en: Human-readable description of access and use restrictions for the LCA / EPD study (equivalent to dcterms:accessRights).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the attribute @epd:scenario on epd:amount.

comment.en: Identifier of the scenario this LCIAModuleValue applies to (free-text label matching the EPD's scenario declaration).

Indicates whether the manufacturer identified in this record directly provided primary LCA data for the study. Set to true for the reference manufacturer; may be false for manufacturers listed for traceability only.
Link from an LCAStudy to a Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules document (1..n).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element compliance/referenceToComplianceSystem.

comment.en: Link from a ComplianceDeclaration to the standard or programme it references (EN 15804+A2, ISO 14025, ISO 21930, etc.).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the element epd2:referenceToOriginalEPD.

comment.en: Link from the machine-readable EPDStudy to the published EPD document (typically PDF).
Link from an EN15804Indicator individual to the indicator EN15804IndicatorGroup it belongs to (core impact, with-caveats, resource use, waste, valorisation, exported energy).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element time/referenceYear on processDataSet.

comment.en: Start year of the time period for which the study is valid.

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the element referenceToModelSource.

comment.en: Link from an ImpactModel to the bibliographic source(s) describing the characterisation model.
Link from a Method to the formal LCIA method report (e.g. the EF 3.1 method description).

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD+EPD extension: Corresponds to the attribute @epd2:epd-version on processDataSet.

comment.en: Version tag of the ILCD+EPD format used (e.g. "1.3").

sourceVocabulary.value: ILCD base: Corresponds to the attribute review/@type.

comment.en: The kind of review performed (independent external, accredited third party, etc.).
